findings.body: The required Done-when remains unmet. Although bare identifiers are now excluded, the guard still drops legitimate comparisons such as “Show Actual is 500” or “spend equals 500”: these state an amount comparison, but the pattern on this line recognizes neither `is` nor `equals`, so the value filter is removed at line 41. The unchanged selector prompt at `backend/src/llm/llm.constants.ts:56-61` still does not say never to add an unstated comparison. Finally, the new Ask tests use `FakeLlm` and `FakeExecutor` (`chat.service.test.ts:3117-3119`) and return one fixture row; neither they nor the supplied branch record prove that DUB and CHIR return all 81 statement lines in 4 of 4 live runs through the real API, database, and Bedrock selector.
